How Review Management works in Noxtill, and where to check
How can a business manage customer reviews across websites?

Connect your review sites to Noxtill so reviews from Google, Facebook and other platforms arrive in one inbox, then read, reply and follow up from there. It is a review management platform for small business teams and doubles as manage Google reviews software, since Google reviews are answered in the same place.
How does Review Management software help a small business, and what should buyers evaluate?

Replying quickly and consistently builds trust and shows customers you listen. When comparing customer review monitoring software, business reputation management software or multi location review management, check platform coverage, reply tools, review requests, alerts and reporting.
